name: Atelier No.8
tagline: Objects with a point of view.
description: A precise identity for a collectible-object atelier. A faceted diamond, antique mauve, and high-contrast serif lettering lend small editions a sense of enduring value.
heading: cormorant
rules: Keep diamond facets outlined at a consistent weight.
Use edition numbers and object dimensions as deliberate typographic details.
Allow old gold only as a line or a small seal.

system.concept: Faceted sculptural objects, edition stamps, restrained mauve fields, and exquisitely proportioned serif typography. Every object is treated as a small piece of architecture.
headline: A few objects.
A distinct point of view.
system.productNote: Material, with a point of view.
features: A considered form, a clear material, and a reason to exist.
Small decisions that reward looking a little closer.
Objects whose personality can outlast the first impression.
system.layoutNote: Ivory split hero with an aubergine serif and a large faceted object. Numbered editions, mono dimensions, fine gold rules, and square image frames.
